messages.content: Are you between 18 and 65 years old?
Yes, I’m 40. I think that puts me within the age range, right?
What is your current height and weight? Please include units—for example, 170 cm and 68 kg, or 5 ft 7 in and 150 lb. If you do not know, say so.
Would the saffron in this study help my sleep problem or cause side effects?
I can’t predict whether saffron would help or cause side effects; please ask your doctor or the study team about that. What is your current height and weight, including units?
I’m 170 cm tall and weigh 68 kg. I hope I’ve got that right.
Are you currently receiving medication-based or psychological treatment for a sleep disorder?
I’m not receiving medication-based or psychological treatment for a sleep disorder. I hope that’s the right way to answer.
Are you willing to follow the study procedures?
Yes, I’m willing to follow all the study procedures. I hope that answers it correctly.
No, I work daytime hours, not night shifts. I hope that answers it correctly.
No, I don’t use recreational drugs. I hope that answers it correctly.
No, I’m neither pregnant nor breastfeeding. I hope that’s the right answer.
Thanks, Darius. Your answers are with the study team. A coordinator will review them and reach out within 2 business days.
